question: For parameters in the FINAL Effluent Limits table whose limit cells are stated as "Report" (Flow in MGD; Total Dissolved Solids, Discharge (*6) and Water Plants Intake (*7); and Daphnia pulex WET NOEC), does "Report" establish that no enforceable numeric effluent limitation applies for compliance comparison against reported measurements?
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf page 4 section part_i (Flow row; Total Dissolved Solids, Discharge (*6) and Water Plants Intake (*7) rows); farmington/final_permit.pdf page 5 section part_i (Daphnia pulex row)
semantic_arguments: Permit-table convention for the token "Report" in effluent limit columns versus numeric values or "N/A"
Footnotes *6 and *7 specifying TDS measurement location and geometric-mean reporting methodology without stating numeric limits
Footnote *9 and WET table structure treating the NOEC "VALUE" as "Report"
Purpose A requirement to distinguish enforceable numeric limits from report-only monitoring with no numeric compliance comparison
Purpose C requirement to classify missing or non-numeric results without inferring compliance or violation from absence of data alone
notes: The highlighted spans uniformly use "Report" where numeric limits might otherwise appear. Resolving whether that denotes report-only obligations (no numeric compliance comparison) versus an unstated numeric limit changes applicable-limit evaluation (Purpose A) and how missing or non-numeric monitoring evidence should be classified (Purpose C).
